headline: Podemos confirms support for the two decrees: "The Tenants' Unions asked us to back the measures and we are going to answer that call"
summary: Podemos confirmed support for two government housing decrees, saying tenants' unions asked it to back the measures. An encampment at Puerta del Sol is in its fifth day.
why: Housing decrees in Spain can alter rental rules and affect landlords, property investors and listed real estate firms with Spanish exposure.

original_headline: Podemos confirma su apoyo a los dos decretos: "Los Sindicatos de Inquilinas nos han pedido que respaldemos las medidas y vamos a asumir ese llamado"
